commitResults.messageTitle: Parser: Refine prefix detection and validation
commitResults.messageBody:
Replace character-by-character prefix checks with compiled regular expressions for the literal-space --[A-Za-z0-9]+ syntax. Validate the complete extracted prefix separately so bare dashes and malformed tokens remain ordinary input.

Simplify prefix scanning by skipping invalid candidates with an early continue, keeping the valid-prefix path flat. Update tokenizer, parser, and validator tests to cover malformed prefixes and the alphanumeric prefix format.

commitResults.messageTitle: Parser: Improve tag parsing and add clearTags edit flag
commitResults.messageBody:
Require every --tag value to be non-empty and alphanumeric, and remove the previous parser-local behavior that treated a lone --tag as a request to clear tags.

Add --clearTags as a valueless option supported only by editStudent and editPlan. Validate its associated field value through ParserUtil.validateEmptyField, then apply the empty tag-set override after ordinary tag parsing so invalid tags still fail while valid tags are discarded when --clearTags is present.

Keep prefix structure and duplicate-prefix validation in ArgumentValidator, while keeping FieldValueInvalidException construction within ParserUtil. Update command usage text, user documentation, test utilities, parser and command tests, and remove redundant parser-level validation tests.

Closes #251

Closes #245

commitResults.messageTitle: Feature: Update edit tag for students and plans to preserve existing tags
commitResults.messageBody:
Replace replacement-style tag editing with explicit add, delete, and clear
operations for students and workout plans.

Changes:
- Replace the --tag prefix with --addTag across addStudent and addPlan.
- Add --addTag, --deleteTag, and --clearTags support to editStudent and
  editPlan.
- Preserve existing tags when using --addTag.
- Ignore duplicate additions and deletions of absent tags.
- Apply --clearTags before additions so clear-plus-add leaves only the new
  tags.
- Reject tags supplied to both --addTag and --deleteTag.
- Report conflicting tag names deterministically in sorted order.
- Keep structural prefix validation in ArgumentValidator.
- Keep field-value and tag conflict validation in ParserUtil.
- Update edit descriptors, execution logic, usage messages, documentation,
  test utilities, and parser/command tests.

No model or storage schema changes are required. Tags continue to be stored
as sets under the existing student and workout-plan JSON fields.

Testing:
- Passed the full Gradle test suite.
- Passed main and test Checkstyle.
- Passed 234 temporary alpha-test assertions covering parsing, execution,
  validation, conflicts, JSON persistence, restart behavior, and duplicate
  handling.

commitResults.messageTitle: Expose current student as an observable property
commitResults.messageBody:
Model has no observable student selection, so UI code cannot subscribe
to changes in model selection.

Add a read-only property to Model and keep it consistent when
students are replaced, removed, or reset. Expose the property through
Logic and test model behavior and reference delegation.

commitResults.messageTitle: Update Model stub for current student API
commitResults.messageBody:
The AddStudentCommand test stub lacks the new Model methods, preventing
the test sources from compiling.

Add fail-fast implementations so the stub matches the interface
without changing the behavior under test.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add student and workout plan tags in Model
commitResults.messageBody:
Student and workout plan tags need distinct types, while existing
student callers still use the generic Tag API.

Store typed tags in each model and retain the legacy Student API for
migration. Include workout plan tags in its string output.

Make equality behavior explicit for generic, student, and workout plan
tags.

commitResults.messageTitle: Restore readable command text in Workout Plan
commitResults.messageBody:
Workout plan commands display plans through toString(), so the
diagnostic builder output appears in user-facing messages.

Restore the readable format for untagged plans and append sorted tags
when a plan has them.
Add parser for editPlan command

Student and workout plan tags already use distinct concrete types. The
legacy Student constructors and generic tag getter leave an unused path
for creating and converting plain tags.

Make Tag abstract, remove the legacy Student adapters, and expose the
typed student tags through getTags(). Update callers and tests to use
the unified getter name.

UserGuide: Update features to include new command formats for BrotherGym

Add a status enum and constructor, default existing constructors to
PENDING, and include status in plan equality.
Add Workout Plan status
Parser: Reject invalid prefixes from input string

Add a model API that refreshes one student's plans and returns the
stored student. Recompute statuses using the local date and replace
immutable objects only when their status changes.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add workout plan mark and unmark APIs
commitResults.messageBody:
Workout plans have statuses, but callers cannot explicitly mark a plan
as completed or restore its date-based status.

Add immutable mark and unmark operations on plans and their ordered
lists. Reuse the status refresh rule so unmarked past plans become
overdue and other unmarked plans become pending.

Model operations provide little detail about attempts and completed
updates, making changes to students and selections hard to trace.

Log initialization, settings, student updates, and selection changes
with lazy messages to avoid formatting disabled log entries.

Student log entries include workout plan lists, but the default object
representation hides their contents.

Render each plan in list order so logs show the associated workouts.

Plan commands rebuild and replace a student when workout plans change.

Add Model operations that perform this replacement with immutable values.
Format workout plan messages
Model: Add workout plan operations

Workout plan commands duplicate list checks and can expose generic
index failures. Student selection can also accept a student absent
from the model, leaving validation dependent on callers.

Enforce plan rules in the model and validate stored students in
BrotherGym. Translate domain failures in commands and cover the
new boundaries with focused tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Model: Restore student list null validation
commitResults.messageBody:
Bulk student replacement uses a dedicated exception for null entries,
which changes the previous validation contract.

Restore the shared null check and cover invalid replacements through
UniqueStudentList and BrotherGym. Verify that existing data remains
unchanged when a replacement fails.
EditPlanCommand: Preserve workout plan status when editing
Model: Log state changes and render workout plans
Improve validation and exceptions throwing and handling in Model and callers

Workout plan add, remove, and edit operations lack dedicated model logs,
which makes their outcomes hard to trace for each student.

Log attempts at fine level and successful changes at info level,
including the affected student and plan details.

commitResults.messageTitle: Model: Log GUI settings changes at info level
commitResults.messageBody:
GUI settings updates belong with the other successful model changes
logged at info level. Raise the completion message from fine to info so
it appears in the standard application log.

Model collections rely on unique student identities and stable workout
plan positions after mutation. Assert these invariants to reveal internal
regressions during development without changing input validation.

commitResults.messageTitle: Gradle: Enable assertions for the run task
commitResults.messageBody:
The run task starts the application with assertions disabled, so
assertion checks do not run during local development. Enable them to
surface violated assumptions when launching the app through Gradle.

commitResults.messageTitle: docs: Split model class diagram into two views
commitResults.messageBody:
The model diagram combines component structure with entity details,
making the high-level relationships hard to read.

Move Student, tag, and workout plan details into a separate diagram.
Show both views in the Developer Guide and explain the omitted details
in the overview.
Improve defensiveness in Logic component

commitResults.messageTitle: docs: Clarify model data and current student
commitResults.messageBody:
The Model section does not describe workout plan ownership or distinguish
filter results from the student the user chooses to inspect.

Describe where workout plans live, how the filtered list is exposed,
and which student the user intends to view or edit.

commitResults.messageTitle: Prevent duplicate plans with different statuses
commitResults.messageBody:
Workout plans with the same content can coexist for one student when
their statuses differ. Add and edit checks use equality that
includes status, so they miss these duplicates.

Compare plan content without status for duplicate checks. Add
regression tests for Pending, Completed, and Overdue plans.
Student: Prevent case-only duplicate student names
Student: Validate international phone number length

commitResults.messageTitle: Ignore tags when identifying duplicate plans
commitResults.messageBody:
Plans with the same title, description, and date can coexist when
their tags differ. Add and edit checks should reject these plans
regardless of tags or status.

Exclude tags from duplicate identity while retaining full value
equality. Cover differing tags in model and command tests.
Prevent duplicate plans with different statuses
